title: Is the guidance on Shared Team Folders still current?

question.author: member_289
question.body: I found an older discussion about shared team folders. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Access is granted per folder to members or groups. When someone leaves the organization, their personal files are transferred to an admin-designated account and their team folder access is revoked immediately. Team folders cannot be converted back to personal folders. Team folders live in a separate namespace from personal files and are owned by the organization, not by individuals. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
